content.short: Pyth Network provides high-fidelity, high-frequency market data for DeFi applications.
content.description: Pyth Network acts as a decentralized oracle that delivers live financial market data to a range of blockchains. It sources price information from a broad set of contributors, including exchanges and market‑making firms, which continually feed data into the system. By continuously aggregating and validating incoming prices, the network provides timely, high‑quality price feeds for a wide array of asset classes, including US equities, commodities, and cryptocurrencies, helping smart contracts and DeFi applications reference accurate market data.
content.meta: Pyth Network is an oracle that publishes financial market data to multiple blockchains. Discover Pyth Network and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
